name: Oxford Industries, Inc.
summary: Oxford Industries, Inc., an apparel company, designs, sources, markets, and distributes lifestyle products worldwide. The company offers men's and women's sportswear and related products under the Tommy Bahama brand; and women's and girls' dresses and sportswear, scarves, bags, jewelry, and belts, as well as children's apparel, swim, footwear, and licensed products under the Lilly Pulitzer brand.
